payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates all pairs (i,j) of codes, counts matching digits s, and updates k based on s thresholds: if s>=4 then k=0, else if s>=2 then k=1, else keep min(k,2). O(n^2) complete search.
payload.rationale: The solution is a brute-force complete search over all code pairs. It does not use backtracking, bitmasks, or graph traversal, but 'search_backtracking' is the best available complete search subtype from candidates.
